title: Special and Regular City Council Meeting 06/16/26
caveat: Findings from an automated review of an auto-captioned recording. Verify specifics against the video before repeating them.

findings.meeting_summary: The Mattoon City Council held a public hearing on proposed Midtown TIF District boundary extensions followed by a regular meeting. The council addressed several infrastructure decision requests, public comments regarding liquor and gaming licenses, and received committee reports including an update on watershed management.

topics.topic: Water System Planning & Hydraulic Modeling Study
topics.what_happened: The council discussed Council Decision Request 2026-2700 to issue an RFP for a water system planning and hydraulic modeling study. Officials noted the study will evaluate citywide water delivery and treatment plant needs, including potential improvements to filters, lime systems, aeration, and dredging.

Commissioner Clawson reported on attending the initial Watershed Management meeting focused on preserving Lake Mattoon and Lake Paradise. He outlined a two-year plan with the consultant, focusing on data collection in the first year and strategy implementation in the second year.

votes.measure: Approval of Council Decision Request 2026-2700 for RFP solicitation for Water System Planning and Hydraulic Modeling Study
